review_text.en: Although I was a little concerned because the application involved multiple farmland properties, Mr. Fujiwara handled everything carefully and accurately, including preparing the location map, obtaining the land registry and official maps, checking public roads and waterways, and investigating neighboring landowners.He also prepared the draft lease agreement and supporting documents in a short period of time, which was very helpful.Mr. Fujiwara is also a licensed real estate transaction specialist, so I felt reassured by his knowledge of land and buildings. He listens carefully and is a reliable professional.I am now also consulting him about preparing a notarized will.

review_text.en: We supported a construction company that needed to file a change notification for its demolition work registration with both Hyogo Prefecture and Osaka Prefecture due to the retirement of its registered technical supervisor.We organized the required documents and reviewed the qualifications of the new technical supervisor candidates, helping the company prepare the change notification in order to maintain its registration.In addition, we also organized the key points to be confirmed for the company’s future construction business license application, including the full-time engineer’s practical experience, the business management manager requirement, financial foundation, and construction work records.The client told us, “I felt reassured because I could consult not only about the change notification, but also about the future construction business license application.”

review_text.en: The client had completed their marriage procedures overseas and wished to obtain a status of residence so that they could live together in Japan.In international marriage cases, it is important to clearly organize and explain matters such as the marriage procedures in Japan, the status of the marriage overseas, income and living stability, and the history of the relationship.At our office, we supported the client by checking the required documents, preparing the questionnaire and statement of reasons, and organizing the letter of guarantee, income documents, and materials explaining the marital relationship.In particular, because the case involved overseas marriage procedures and foreign-language documents, we carefully organized the application so that the Immigration Services Agency could easily understand the circumstances.As a result, the client was successfully granted the status of residence of “Spouse or Child of Japanese National.”Client’s VoiceThis was a visa application for living in Japan, and we were initially worried because we did not know what documents we needed to prepare.However, the required documents and the flow of the procedure were explained to us clearly, so we were able to proceed with peace of mind.The overseas marriage documents, proof of income, and other parts that would have been difficult for us to handle on our own were carefully organized, which was very helpful.Thanks to the support, we were successfully granted a three-year status of residence, and we are now able to start our life together in Japan.Thank you very much.
review_text.ja: お客様は、海外で婚姻手続きを済ませた後、日本で一緒に生活するための在留資格を取得したいというご相談でした。国際結婚の場合、日本での婚姻手続き、海外での婚姻成立状況、収入・生活基盤、交際経緯などを整理して説明する必要があります。当事務所では、必要書類の確認、質問書・理由書の作成、身元保証書、収入資料、婚姻関係を説明する資料の整理などをサポートしました。特に、海外での婚姻手続きや外国語書類が関係するため、入管に伝わりやすいよう、申請内容を丁寧に整理しました。その結果、無事に「日本人の配偶者等」の在留資格が許可されました。お客様からの声：日本での生活を予定したビザ申請でしたが、何を準備すればよいのか分からず不安でしたが、必要書類や手続きの流れを分かりやすく説明していただき、安心して進めることができました。海外での婚姻届や収入の証明など、自分たちでは難しい部分も丁寧に整理していただき、とても助かりました。無事に3年間の在留資格が許可され、日本で一緒に生活を始めることができました。ありがとうございました。

review_text.en: A client residing in Takarazuka City consulted us regarding inheritance procedures following the passing of a family member.In this case, the deceased person’s registered domicile was located far from the client’s residence. We therefore assisted with obtaining the necessary family registry documents, including the family register, removed family register, and revised original family register, by mail. After confirming the relationship among the heirs, we supported the preparation of the Legal Heir Information List.We then organized the documents required for the inheritance procedures at financial institutions, including obtaining balance certificates, preparing the necessary documents, and arranging powers of attorney. We also assisted with the procedures for closing the deceased person’s bank accounts. In addition, for the inheritance registration of real estate, we worked in cooperation with a judicial scrivener and successfully completed the procedures.The client commented, “At first, I thought I would handle the procedures myself, but I am glad I asked for professional assistance.”
